speaker: sprocket
text: [excited] Welcome to the Training Grounds! Six quick lessons between you and your first race, and nobody can hurt you here. Let's roll!

speaker: sprocket
text: Press left and right to steer.

speaker: sprocket
text: Hold down to fire your Magic Engine. Watch the heat bar.

speaker: sprocket
text: Your skills live on Q W E R and A S D F.

speaker: sprocket
text: Press up or Space to jump the gap.

speaker: sprocket
text: See that tunnel in the cliff? Jump into it to skip a whole section.

speaker: sprocket
text: [laughs] That is it. Now let us go racing.
